name: std::optional<T>::operator->, std::optional<T>::operator*
intro:
Accesses the contained value.

1) Returns a pointer to the contained value.

2) Returns a reference to the contained value.

The behavior is undefined if *this does not contain a value.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: Pointer or reference to the contained value.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: This operator does not check whether the optional contains a value! You can do so manually by using has_value() or simply operator bool(). Alternatively, if checked access is needed, value() or value_or() may be used.
